step: Keep empty rows in the time line; set placeholder Current_J0 = 1.0 to NaN
justification: Removing them glues events together and shifts lags

step: Causal forward fill of sensors (<= 2 s, within segment)
justification: What a real-time system can do; no future value used

step: Segments at breaks > 5 s; no window or label across them
justification: Avoid mixing two sessions in a window

step: Debounce label: merge events separated by <= 2 rows
justification: 1-2 s holes are label flicker, not a new loss; prevents trivially easy positives

step: Early-warning target y = onset in (t, t+3]
justification: Predicting the current second detects consequences (leakage)

step: Remove rows where a loss is ongoing
justification: The alert must come before the loss

step: Residual to the normal cycle profile at the same position
justification: Removes the cycle shape; signal = deviation
